origin: E2 Anime Seinen (male) + E3 Anime Shoujo (female), blended for neutral

male.headShape: angular jaw path with pointed chin
male.noseStyle: bridge line + tip triangle + nostril dot
male.clothingStyle: structured with shoulder armor plates, high collar, V-collar opening, seam lines

female.mouthStyle: small tinted lips with subtle fill
female.clothingStyle: elegant curved neckline, decorative gem clasp, accent trim, dashed center seam

neutral.headShape: moderate jaw path — rounded V-chin between angular and oval
neutral.mouthStyle: simple curved line, no tint fill
neutral.clothingStyle: clean mandarin collar with accent-colored piping, center seam

hairAndEyes.principle: Hair and eyes are the primary differentiators between individual operators. The structural base (head, body, clothing) stays consistent within each presentation family. Authored and generated operators must both resolve to the same recipe contract before reaching the modular builder.
hairGuidelines: Hair defines the head silhouette and must read clearly at roster size (h-14 / ~56px tall)
Render as layered paths: a back layer behind the head, a front layer overlapping the forehead
Stroke outlines should match the presentation base weight (male 2.0, female 1.3, neutral 1.6)
Include 1-3 subtle strand/highlight lines for texture (low opacity, clothingLight color)
Hair color comes from the palette hair field, but creative color variation is welcome for special operators
Each operator should have a distinct hair silhouette — this is the primary recognition cue at small sizes
eyeGuidelines: Eyes define personality: narrow = intense, ornate = beautiful, sharp = fierce, round = warm
Include a visible iris with at least one white highlight dot
Upper eyelid line is always the heaviest eye stroke
Male eyes tend narrower/horizontal, female eyes tend taller/ornate, neutral is between — but these are guidelines, not rules
Iris color typically derives from the accent palette but creative variation is welcome
At minimum: eye white shape, iris fill, pupil, one highlight, upper lid stroke
hairAndEyes.colorFreedom: Hair color, eye color, and iris detail are intentionally unconstrained. Future operators may have unusual hair colors, heterochromia, glowing eyes, or other distinguishing features. The structural style (cel-shade, outline weights, shadow treatment) is what must stay consistent, not the specific colors.
